name: LMSubs
description: OpenAI-compatible ASR (speech-to-text) + LLM subtitle translation. Works like OpenSubtitles: search and download 'LM Subtitles' in the Edit Subtitles dialog; the server generates the full subtitle, which Jellyfin then saves and registers. Provider presets plus configurable Base URL / API Key / Model. Completed results are cached. No web modification.
overview: ASR transcription + LLM subtitle translation (OpenSubtitles-style download flow)

versions.changelog: Task list decoupled from subtitle entries: one ASR row per item + one Translate row per language (kind asr|translate). Downloads are triggers, not tasks. Delete takes source or a language.
Fixed entry names (LM Subtitles - Source/Translate/Bilingual). Completed shows '(Completed)' on model lines instead of 'Ready (cached)'. Tasks: one ASR + one Translate row per language.
Fix Ready (cached) badge missing for legacy caches in search results (ISO code vs language slug mismatch).
Translated and bilingual share one translation job per language (translate once, two renders). No double LLM cost; deleting either cache removes both. Legacy caches still served.
Cache hit on download returns immediately without restarting the ASR session or waiting.

Search lists three entries — Source / Translated / Bilingual — sharing one ASR pass; translation only runs for translated/bilingual downloads. 'Include translation' and 'Subtitle style' settings removed. Source track uses the video's metadata language.

Tasks list on the settings page (running + completed, incl. cache-only after restart) with Stop/Delete. Delete clears plugin cache only; downloaded subtitle files are kept. New REST GET /LmSubs/Tasks and DELETE /LmSubs/Tasks/{itemId}.

Silence-aware subtitle timing for timestamp-less ASR: ffmpeg silencedetect locates speech ranges per chunk; sentences skip pauses and snap to silence edges. Configurable noise floor / min silence length. Proportional fallback preserved.
Sentence-first cue splitting: cut at sentence-ending punctuation before length-based splits; long sentences break at clause punctuation. No more mid-sentence cuts for timestamp-less ASR text.
Context size setting: token-budgeted translate batches (default 6000 est. tokens, 0=unlimited). Provider context-overflow errors now split and retry the batch instead of failing the job.
Remove dead ASR concurrency setting. Debounce duplicate download clicks (no duplicate subtitle tracks). Plugin-only Log level setting with Debug process logs (per ASR chunk / translation batch).
ASR shared across target languages: one transcription per item, second language reuses transcript and progress (translation-only cost). Per-language translations run in parallel.
Fix ffmpeg not found: use Jellyfin's resolved encoder/probe paths (IMediaEncoder) instead of bare 'ffmpeg', which is not on PATH in the official container.

Search entry renamed to 'LM Subtitles' with model/target details in the description. Target language comes from the search dialog language (setting removed). Re-search while generating shows live ASR/Translate progress percentages.
Target Jellyfin 10.11 (.NET 9). Fixes MissingMethodException on search when running on 10.11 servers (GetItemList signature changed).
Fix 'no results' in Edit Subtitles search: register provider as ISubtitleProvider (SubtitleManager resolves IEnumerable<ISubtitleProvider>).
Settings page: Advanced section single column; clearer translation-toggle label.
OpenSubtitles-style flow: generate via Edit Subtitles -> search -> download; full sequential generation; removed injected tracks and playback-event triggers; REST API retained.
